description: Header file defining the TranscoderWrapper class, which implements TranscoderInterface for media transcoding operations, including start, pause, resume, stop, and internal event handling.

classes.name: TranscoderWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class around MediaTranscoder implementing TranscoderInterface for media transcoding control.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Internal struct representing different types of events in the transcoding process.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a transcoding session with specified client and session IDs, request parameters, and callback.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused transcoding session with given request parameters.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops a transcoding session, with optional abandonment.
